title: Reactive Streams demand buffer integer overflow causing dropped backpressure frames
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0883: Reactive Streams demand buffer integer overflow causing dropped backpressure frames
Repository: `golang/go`
Category: `Asynchronous Event Loop Deadlocks`
Target File: `reactive/streams/Subscription.java`

#### Problem Description
Subscriber requests Long.MAX_VALUE while buffer already contains pending demand, wrapping to negative value.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Cap requested demand addition at Long.MAX_VALUE using Math.min arithmetic.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0883.py -q`
expected_invariant: Cap requested demand addition at Long.MAX_VALUE using Math.min arithmetic.
